about_the_game:
Take control of your speeding delivery package in this fast-paced 3D obstacle runner where precision and quick reflexes are your only lifeline. Your goal? Survive the highway, avoid obstacles, and reach your final delivery destination at 25,000 meters.

Speed-Based Challenge: The further you go, the faster it gets. Keep your focus sharp.

Dynamic Obstacles: Dodge walls and hazards that spawn in random patterns every run.

Power Pads: Boost and Slow Pads create moments of intensity and strategy.

Ramp Launches: Fly off ramps with cinematic flair—if you land it right.

One-Mistake Death System: Crash once, and it's game over. No mercy.

High Score Tracking: Compete with yourself and reach new milestones with every attempt.

Stylized 3D Aesthetic: Minimalist, modern visuals for a clean and vibrant atmosphere.

Pause, Settings, and Mute Options: Built-in quality-of-life features to let you play on your terms.

This is my first Unity Game. I learned a lot and had fun working on this project. 

Special thanks to...
Brackeys for making this possible.
Music: JUANJO_SOUND
SFX: Dustyroom, VoiceBosch, SoundBits, Olivier Giardot
UI: MadFireOn, Mr_Command_Coder

Feedback and support from...
Bryan, Danny, Daniel, Dab

Look out for my next project!
Follow MindPlayPark

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.4 GHz) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Internal PCIe Sound Card
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard required. Runs on most modern laptops and desktops.
